newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Amara Holdings offers 132 mln shares at S$0.30.
newsitem.headline: Amara Holdings offers 132 mln shares at S$0.30.

text.p: Amara Holdings Pte Ltd said on Friday it was offering a total of 132 million shares at Singapore $0.30 each in its initial public offer.
The offer comprises 120 million new shares and 12 million vendor shares.
The public issue comprises 79.2 million offer shares and 52.8 million placement shares.
Net proceeds are expected to be S$34.2 million and will be used to fund the group's plans to expand in Singapore and the region, the company said.
The historical price earnings ratio is 21.4 times based on the year ended December 31, 1996, the company said.
The forecast price earnings ratio based on the year end 1997 is 20.0 and the stock begins trading on August 15, the company added.
